knowledgePoints.title: 语法 · There be 句型
knowledgePoints.content: There be 表示「某处有某物」，be 动词跟**离它最近的那个名词**一致（就近原则）：There is a book and two pens. / There are two pens and a book. 否定句和疑问句里 some 要变 any。

knowledgePoints.title: 语法 · be 动词与 have / has
knowledgePoints.content: am 配 I，is 配第三人称单数，are 配 you/we/they 和复数。have 配 I/you/we/they，has 配第三人称单数（he/she/it/Amy）。

knowledgePoints.title: 语法 · 名词所有格
knowledgePoints.content: 表示「谁的」：名词后加 's（John's classroom）。形容词性物主代词（my/your/her/his）后面**必须跟名词**；名词性物主代词（mine/yours/hers）**单独使用**，后面不再跟名词。

knowledgePoints.title: 语法 · 形容词构词与词类
knowledgePoints.content: 常见构词：名词 + y（rain→rainy）、名词 + ful（help→helpful）、名词 + ly（friend→friendly）。注意 snow 是名词/动词，snowy 才是形容词。

knowledgePoints.title: 语法 · 职业词汇与词形变化
knowledgePoints.content: 职业词：doctor / nurse / farmer / driver / cleaner / cook / firefighter / police officer / delivery worker。第三人称单数动词加 -s/-es；表示一类人时名词要用复数（cleaners, firefighters）。

exercises.question:
【句型】她是医生。
— What's your mother's job? — She's a ____ .
exercises.explanation: 她是医生。 →「— What's your mother's job? — She's a doctor .」

exercises.question:
【句型】爸爸妈妈又忙又累。
Mum and Dad are ____ and tired.
exercises.explanation: 爸爸妈妈又忙又累。 →「Mum and Dad are busy and tired.」

exercises.question:
【句型】我们可以做一些家务活。
We can do some ____ .
exercises.explanation: 我们可以做一些家务活。 →「We can do some chores .」

exercises.question:
【句型】他是工厂工人。
He is a factory ____ .
exercises.explanation: 他是工厂工人。 →「He is a factory worker .」

units.title: Unit 2 · My friends
units.desc: 我的朋友 · 14 个单词 + 4 个句型

exercises.question: 【单词默写】中文；中国人；中国的 → （　）
exercises.explanation: 中文；中国人；中国的 → Chinese

exercises.question:
【句型】他又高又壮。
He's tall and ____ .
exercises.explanation: 他又高又壮。 →「He's tall and strong .」

exercises.question:
【句型】他也很友善，他经常帮助我。
He's also ____ . He often helps me.
exercises.explanation: 他也很友善，他经常帮助我。 →「He's also kind . He often helps me.」

exercises.question:
【句型】谁是你最好的朋友？
— Who's your ____ friend? — Chen Jie.
exercises.explanation: 谁是你最好的朋友？ →「— Who's your best friend? — Chen Jie.」

exercises.question:
【句型】她经常让我开心。
She often makes me ____ .
exercises.explanation: 她经常让我开心。 →「She often makes me smile .」

units.desc: 我们居住的地方 · 18 个单词 + 4 个句型

topics.desc: 我们居住的地方 · Places we live in

exercises.question:
【句型】那里有个游乐场，我们经常在那里玩儿。
There is a ____ . We often play there.
exercises.explanation: 那里有个游乐场，我们经常在那里玩儿。 →「There is a playground . We often play there.」

exercises.question:
【句型】我最喜欢的地方是博物馆。
My favourite ____ is the museum.
exercises.explanation: 我最喜欢的地方是博物馆。 →「My favourite place is the museum.」

exercises.question:
【句型】太棒了！我们一起做运动吧。
Great! Let's do some ____ .
exercises.explanation: 太棒了！我们一起做运动吧。 →「Great! Let's do some sports .」

exercises.question:
【句型】我们可以去图书馆。
We can go to the ____ .
exercises.explanation: 我们可以去图书馆。 →「We can go to the library .」

topics.title: 单词默写（13 个）
topics.desc: 在社区帮忙 · Helping in the community

exercises.question: 【单词默写】大量；许多 → （　）
exercises.explanation: 大量；许多 → a lot of

exercises.question: 【单词默写】过去的；年纪大的；老的 → （　）

exercises.question:
【句型】我们的邻居是消防员，他经常帮助别人。
Our neighbour is a ____ . He often helps people.
exercises.explanation: 我们的邻居是消防员，他经常帮助别人。 →「Our neighbour is a firefighter . He often helps people.」

exercises.question:
【句型】他是校车司机，他每天送我们去学校。
He's a school bus ____ . He takes us to school every day.
exercises.explanation: 他是校车司机，他每天送我们去学校。 →「He's a school bus driver . He takes us to school every day.」

exercises.question:
【句型】那个工作也很重要！
That's an ____ job too.
exercises.explanation: 那个工作也很重要！ →「That's an important job too.」

exercises.question:
【句型】陈杰正在铺床。
Chen Jie is ____ the bed.
exercises.explanation: 陈杰正在铺床。 →「Chen Jie is making the bed.」

topics.desc: 天气与我们 · The weather and us

exercises.question: 【单词默写】他们的；她们的；它们的 → （　）
exercises.explanation: 他们的；她们的；它们的 → their

exercises.question:
【句型】悉尼的天气怎么样？
What's the ____ like in Sydney?
exercises.explanation: 悉尼的天气怎么样？ →「What's the weather like in Sydney?」

exercises.question:
【句型】北京只有两度。
It's only two ____ in Beijing.
exercises.explanation: 北京只有两度。 →「It's only two degrees in Beijing.」

exercises.question:
【句型】他们的孩子在泳池里游泳。
Their children swim in the ____ .
exercises.explanation: 他们的孩子在泳池里游泳。 →「Their children swim in the pool .」

exercises.question:
【句型】这是谁的毛衣，妈妈？
— ____ sweater is this, Mum? — It's your dad's.
exercises.explanation: 这是谁的毛衣，妈妈？ →「— Whose sweater is this, Mum? — It's your dad's.」

exercises.question:
【句型】你喜欢哪个季节？
— ____ season do you like? — Winter.
exercises.explanation: 你喜欢哪个季节？ →「— Which season do you like? — Winter.」

exercises.question:

exercises.question:

Yes, but wear a ____ too.
exercises.explanation: 可以，但是再穿一件外套吧。 →「Yes, but wear a coat too.」

units.name: 语法专项
units.title: 语法专项 · 周末练习
units.desc: There be、be/have、名词所有格、形容词构词、词形变化

exercises.question: There ____ some oranges on the tree.
exercises.explanation: oranges 是复数，There be 用 are。

exercises.question: There is some ____ on the plate.
exercises.explanation: is 后面跟不可数名词；bread 不可数，apple 和 bananas 都要用复数形式配 are。

exercises.question: He ____ some cool shoes.
exercises.explanation: 主语 He 是第三人称单数，用 has。

exercises.question: ____ some trees on both sides of the street.
exercises.explanation: trees 是复数，用 There are；陈述句不用倒装 Are there。

exercises.question: There ____ a bed, two chairs, three toys and four books in the bedroom.
exercises.explanation: There be 的「就近原则」：看离 be 最近的名词 a bed（单数），所以用 is。

exercises.question: There ____ two birds and a monkey in the tree.
exercises.explanation: 离 be 最近的是 two birds（复数），用 are。

exercises.question: There ____ a pencil, some books and a ruler in my bag.
exercises.explanation: 就近的是 a pencil（单数），用 is。

exercises.question: There aren't ____ apples in the basket.
exercises.explanation: 否定句里用 any，不用 some。

exercises.question: There isn't ____ water in the glass.
exercises.explanation: 否定句用 any；water 不可数，也不能用 many。

topics.title: be 动词与 have / has（5 题）

exercises.question: Amy ____ a small mouth.
exercises.explanation: Amy 是第三人称单数，用 has。

exercises.question: — What do you ____ ? — We ____ six oranges.
exercises.explanation: do 后面用动词原形 have；We 是复数主语，也用 have。

exercises.question: I ____ a lovely cat. It ____ a long tail.
exercises.explanation: I 用 have；It 是第三人称单数用 has。

exercises.question: Little Peter ____ two toy pandas. They ____ black and white.
exercises.explanation: Peter 单数用 has；They 复数用 are。

exercises.question: — Is that ____ cap? — Yes, it is.
exercises.explanation: cap 是名词，前面要用形容词性物主代词 your；yours 后面不能再跟名词。

exercises.question: ____ Mike, ____ eyes are big.
exercises.explanation: 句首要主语 He's（He is）；eyes 前用形容词性物主代词 His。

exercises.question: This is ____ sister. ____ name is Lisa.
exercises.explanation: sister 前用 my；name 前用 Her。

exercises.question: — Is this ____ toy? — No, it's not ____ .
exercises.explanation: toy 前用 your；句末不跟名词时用名词性物主代词 mine。

exercises.question: Kate: Is this ____ schoolbag, Chen Jie?
Chen Jie: No. Amy has a panda schoolbag. Maybe it's ____ .
exercises.explanation: 句末独立使用，用名词性物主代词 hers。

exercises.question: Kate: Hello, Amy. Is this ____ ?
exercises.explanation: 后面没有名词，用名词性物主代词 yours。

exercises.question: Look at this photo ____ my family.
exercises.explanation: 「一张我家的照片」用 a photo of my family。

exercises.question: Is that your ____ bird?
exercises.explanation: 鸟是哥哥的，要用所有格 brother's。

topics.title: 形容词构词与词类（16 题）

exercises.question: 名词 + y 构成形容词：wind → windy，Sun → ____
exercises.explanation: sun + n + y → sunny（双写 n 再加 y）。

exercises.question: 名词 + y 构成形容词：wind → windy，rain → ____
名词 + ful 构成形容词：colour → colourful，help → ____
名词 + ful 构成形容词：colour → colourful，care → ____
名词 + ly 构成形容词：year → yearly，friend → ____
名词 + ly 构成形容词：year → yearly，love → ____
选出不同类的一项：
exercises.explanation: rain 可作名词/动词，sunny 和 windy 都是形容词。

exercises.question: 选出不同类的一项：
exercises.explanation: snowman 是名词（雪人），其余两个是形容词。

exercises.question: 选出不同类的一项：
exercises.explanation: red、blue 是具体的颜色，colour 是「颜色」这个总称。

exercises.question: 选出不同类的一项：
exercises.explanation: friend 是名词，其余两个是形容词。

exercises.question: 选出不同类的一项：
exercises.explanation: hurry 是动词，hungry 和 happy 是形容词。

exercises.question: It is ____ and ____ . Children are having fun in the snow.
exercises.explanation: and 连接两个形容词；snow 是名词/动词，这里要用形容词 snowy。

exercises.question: It is -5℃. It's ____ in Beijing now.
____ warm and cloudy today.
exercises.explanation: 说天气用 It 作主语：It's warm and cloudy.

exercises.question: — Mike, it's ____ now. — Oh no! We can't play basketball in the park.
exercises.explanation: It's + 动词-ing 表示「正在下雨」：It's raining now.

exercises.question: It's ____ here. It's fun to play football in the park.
exercises.explanation: 能在公园踢足球，说明天气晴好，选 sunny。

topics.title: 职业词汇与词形变化（10 题）

exercises.question: Mr Green ____ English in a primary school.
exercises.explanation: Mr Green 是第三人称单数，teach 加 -es → teaches。

exercises.question: Mike is ill. His father takes him to see the ____ .
My ____ is a good writer. I like his stories.
exercises.explanation: 「我的叔叔是一位好作家」，选 uncle。

exercises.question: What's your ____ job? Is he a worker?
exercises.explanation: 「你爸爸的工作是什么」，名词所有格 father's。

exercises.question: She is a ____ . She grows fruit and feeds animals.
exercises.explanation: 种水果、养牲口的是农民 farmer。

exercises.question: Yang Liping is a ____ . She is good at Chinese folk dance.
exercises.explanation: 擅长中国民族舞的是舞蹈家 dancer。

exercises.question: My father is a ____ . He ____ a taxi.（drive）
exercises.explanation: 「司机」是 driver；第三人称单数 drive → drives。两空用逗号隔开。

exercises.question: Susan likes ____ . She wants to be a ____ in the future.（cook）
exercises.explanation: like doing sth → cooking；「厨师」是 cook。两空用逗号隔开。

exercises.question: There are some ____ on the street. They usually ____ the streets in the early morning.（clean）
exercises.explanation: 「清洁工」是 cleaner，some 后用复数 cleaners；they 后接动词原形 clean。

exercises.question: There is a fire in the school. The ____ go there and help.（firefighter）
exercises.explanation: 「消防队员」firefighter，The ... go 说明是复数 firefighters。
